api: OpenAI Responses API for embedding web browsing in applications.
cons: Consumer data terms differ from enterprise
Real-world commitments require explicit authorization scope
Credential access creates phishing attack surface
name: Operator (OpenAI)
pros: Web task completion without user interaction for each step
files: Web content encountered during task execution.
value: A web-browsing agent that completes tasks on the open web on behalf of the user: booking, ordering, form completion, and web-based research without the user typing each step. The first OpenAI product to take actions with real-world consequences by default.
engine: GPT models with computer use capabilities for browser control.
latency: Task completion takes minutes to hours depending on complexity.

pricing.includes: Web browsing tool integration in API applications

quality: Capable for well-defined web tasks. Less reliable on complex multi-step transactions or sites with unusual flows.
tagline: OpenAI's consumer computer-use agent, currently the widest-deployed agentic AI product.
use_cases: Completing multi-step web tasks such as booking, ordering, and form submission
Web research that requires clicking through multiple sources rather than a single search
Automating repetitive web workflows on behalf of an individual user
integrations: OpenAI Responses API for developer embedding
governance_note: The first mainstream product to make 'AI can do things on the web on your behalf' a consumer experience rather than a developer build. The governance questions are: what is it authorized to commit, what credentials does it access, and what happens if it completes the wrong transaction. For enterprise use, those are policy decisions. For consumer use, they are the user's problem, which is part of why the enterprise and consumer versions need different evaluations. Phishing attacks that impersonate Operator to capture credentials are an emerging threat model that comes with this capability.
training_optout: OpenAI's commercial and consumer terms differ. Consumer ChatGPT data terms apply unless the enterprise API is used. Operator actions are taken under the user's session on third-party sites.
